content: If you close your eyes to the facts of the trail, you will learn them through painful collisions.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: Denial is an expensive luxury that reality always bankrupts. You can pretend that debt does not exist, that an illness is trivial, or that a toxic habit causes no harm. But closing your eyes to the boulder does not remove it from the path; it only ensures you smash into it.
practicalInsight: Look squarely at the one uncomfortable financial, physical, or relational fact you have been avoiding today.
reflectionPrompt: What truth about your current life situation are you keeping your eyes closed to, hoping it will simply vanish?
